name: v6-g-lr
note: V6 iteration 5. Evidence on the development tasks: every curriculum variant reaches the same transfer level (unseen-v1 code-only loss: C 0.739 at 24 steps, D 0.676, E 0.672, F 0.677 at 72 steps; round 54 1.164) and new-concept pass rates stay at 1-2/53, whatever the depth (D), formats (E) or breadth (F) of the data: the data no longer limits it. D's training loss flattened in its decay phase (0.30). Changed variable vs D: the learning rate, 1.5e-5 -> 3e-5 (Lion: each weight moves at most lr per step, so 72 steps move it at most ~1e-3 at 1.5e-5). Data (D's, pinned to curriculum v1), legacy share, budget and evaluation as D.
decision: Same pre-registered rule as v6-c-idioms: replaces round 54 only if every seed beats its all_clean (29/168), the mean gain is >= 3 items, and no category loses >= 3 clean items round 54 passes. The benchmark is reported only.
